 Credit Karma Tax is back with free federal filing. Here's what to know
 File your taxes this year with Credit Karma Tax. $0 federal filings and a flat $15 per state filing fee. Roxanne Downer, USA TODAY Mon, November 16, 2026 at 1:19 PM PST 5 min read INTU +1.53%

 Learn more Filing a complicated tax return doesn't necessarily have to come with a complicated price tag.  
 Credit Karma Tax is back, offering free federal filing and a flat $15 fee per state return, regardless of tax complexity. Although it shares a name with the original Credit Karma Tax, the new service— available through the Credit Karma website and app — has a different pricing structure and additional features.  
 The Intuit-owned service allows freelancers, gig workers and taxpayers reporting investment or cryptocurrency transactions to file federal returns for $0. It also offers AI-powered assistance, automatic document imports and options for accessing tax refunds early.  
 Find out if it's the right tool to make your 2026 tax filing easier. 
 How does Credit Karma Tax work?  
 Credit Karma Tax lets users prepare and file federal and state income tax returns through its website or app, with AI-powered guidance throughout the process. Taxpayers who prefer human assistance can purchase the PLUS Bundle or Expert Final Review for an additional fee.  
 The service includes several features designed to simplify tax preparation:  
 Document uploads: Take a photo of a tax document to import information into your return instead of entering everything manually.  
 Automatic imports: Pull eligible tax information from employers and financial institutions, including certain stock and cryptocurrency transactions.  
 AI-powered assistance: Get explanations and help identifying potential errors as you prepare your return.  
 Accuracy checks: Credit Karma Tax runs thousands of checks designed to identify errors before you file.  
 The Credit Karma software supports all IRS forms and schedules, including Schedule C for self-employment income, Schedule D and Form 8949 for investment and cryptocurrency transactions, and Schedule E for rental income. It also supports itemized deductions and other income reported on additional schedules.  
 Credit Karma also offers a Refund Agent that provides personalized suggestions for using refund money toward financial goals, such as paying down debt, saving or investing.  
 Check out Credit Karma Tax 
 Note: As with any tax preparation software, you'll still need to review your information for accuracy before submitting your return.   
 How much does Credit Karma Tax cost?  
 Unlike tax software that reserves certain forms or filing situations for paid tiers, Credit Karma Tax charges the same federal filing price for taxpayers with simple and complex returns.  
 Credit Karma Tax offers free federal filing and charges $15 per state return, regardless of how complicated your taxes are. For example, someone filing one federal and one state return would pay $15 before any optional upgrades, while someone filing returns in two states would pay $30.  
 Story Continues Credit Karma also offers two optional paid services:  
 PLUS Bundle ($29): Provides access to product support specialists and annual audit defense.  
 Expert Final Review ($39): Provides a professional review of your return before filing.

 Note: The $15 state filing fee is subject to change.    
 Is the new Credit Karma Tax the same as the old one?  
 Although it shares the same name, the new Credit Karma Tax is a different product from the original free tax preparation service.  
 The new Credit Karma Tax is an Intuit product available through the Credit Karma website and app. Unlike the original service, which offered free federal and state filing, the new version charges $15 per state return.  
 Can you get your tax refund faster with Credit Karma Tax?  
 Credit Karma Tax offers two ways for eligible taxpayers to access refund money sooner: early direct deposit and a Refund Advance loan.  
 More: IRS adjusts 2027 tax brackets. How your paycheck changes 
 Early refund access  
 Customers who choose to receive their federal tax refund through a Credit Karma Money or Credit Karma Checking account may receive their money up to five days early at no additional cost.  
 Those who prefer to use their own bank account can pay a $35 fee for early refund access. For taxpayers using standard direct deposit, Credit Karma says most refunds arrive within approximately 21 days after IRS acceptance.  
 Refund Advance  
 Eligible taxpayers can also apply for a Refund Advance loan of up to $4,000, issued by WebBank.  
 Unlike early direct deposit, a Refund Advance is a loan against your expected tax refund, not an early payment of the refund itself. The loan has a 0% annual percentage rate (APR) and no fees. If approved, you could receive the funds in a free Credit Karma Checking account within minutes of the IRS accepting your return.  
 Note: Approval isn't guaranteed. Eligibility depends on factors including the taxpayer's location and other program requirements.   
 More: Do you qualify for IRS tax relief? Here's how to check 
 What guarantees does Credit Karma Tax offer?  
 Credit Karma Tax advertises a maximum tax outcome guarantee and a 100% accuracy guarantee .   
 Maximum tax outcome guarantee: If you file an amended return using another tax-preparation method and receive a larger refund, Credit Karma says it will pay you $30.   
 100% accuracy guarantee: If a qualifying software calculation error results in IRS penalties or interest, Credit Karma says it will cover those charges.   
 Bottom line: Is Credit Karma Tax worth using?  
 Credit Karma Tax could be worth considering if you have a complicated return but don't want to pay extra for federal filing. Its flat-rate pricing may be especially appealing to freelancers, gig workers and taxpayers reporting investment or rental income.  
 The software's support for a broad range of IRS forms is another advantage, particularly for taxpayers who might otherwise need a paid tax-preparation tier.  
 For taxpayers comfortable preparing their own returns, Credit Karma Tax offers a potentially affordable option, even when their taxes aren't simple.
